exposure: Foetal tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion (f-TAPSE)
cohort: The study included 168 pregnant women over 32 weeks gestation, divided into groups with normal foetal movements (n=126) and reduced foetal movements (n=42).
finding: Foetuses with poor perinatal outcome had higher MPI and E/A ratios and lower f-TAPSE values, with f-TAPSE being the only parameter independently associated with poor perinatal outcome in pregnancies with RFM.
cross-section timing: During the third trimester, specifically for pregnant women over 32 weeks gestation.
